vendor_highlights: Released gemini-2.0-flash-lite, a generally available (GA) version of Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, which is optimized for speed, scale, and cost efficiency.

changelog.text:
*     The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):

  *   `gemini-2.0-flash`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-001`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001`

  Use [`gemini-3.5-flash`](/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash) or
  [`gemini-3.1-flash-lite`](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite) instead.

*     Deprecation announcement: The following models will be [shut
  down](/docs/deprecations) June 1, 2026:

  *   `gemini-2.0-flash`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-001`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001`

*   Released `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`, a generally available (GA) version of
  [Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite](/docs/models), which is
  optimized for speed, scale, and cost efficiency.
